create_render_settings: create a RenderSettings dataclass instance with default column proportions and token display counts
customize_render_settings: customize RenderSettings to change n_top_tokens, n_promoted_tokens, or attention_color_map values
use_string_to_display: use string_to_display to replace spaces with middle dots for token display formatting
generate_logits_colormap: generate a matplotlib LinearSegmentedColormap for logits visualization with positive and negative color ranges
apply_margins_css: apply the margins_css string to reduce Streamlit padding and set sidebar width
